tasks.label: buildAndRun
tasks.command: DERIVED_DATA="$TMPDIR/snippingToolHost-copilot" && APP="$DERIVED_DATA/Build/Products/Debug/snippingTool.app/Contents/MacOS/snippingTool" && xcodegen generate && xcodebuild build -scheme snippingToolHost -destination 'platform=macOS' -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath "$DERIVED_DATA" && exec "$APP"

tasks.label: runTests
tasks.command: DERIVED_DATA="$TMPDIR/snippingToolHost-copilot" && xcodegen generate && xcodebuild test -scheme snippingToolHost -destination 'platform=macOS' -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath "$DERIVED_DATA"
